description.narrative: Identify and elevate new solutions to address development issues in Sudan through three protocols of operation - solutions mapping, collective intelligence and experimentation to understand what works and what does not, to help us address development challenges in Sudan.

condition.narrative: UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)
